OCR/import issues (particularly scanned, image-only PDFs lacking a text layer) are a primary, direct driver of poor onboarding performance, and they escalate support intervention and remediation workload. Specifically:

- **Onboarding duration impact**: OCR and scanned PDF processing accounts for 25% of all onboarding delay incidents [NL-031#NL-031-S04], alongside permission mapping (45%) and source ingestion cleanup (30%) [NL-012#NL-012-S06]. For example, BrightPath Healthcare experienced the longest onboarding time (9.5 weeks) specifically due to OCR/scanned PDF compliance issues [NL-012#NL-012-S06], and Northstar Financial's pilot kickoff was delayed by three weeks because the customer's IT team had to run files through an external OCR tool [NL-010#NL-010-S06].

- **Go-live quality failures**: Without OCR, scanned PDFs fail to extract a text layer, causing incomplete or missing answers and triggering go-live quality check failures [NL-010#NL-010-S06]. Since the go-live threshold requires an 85% citation correctness rate (90% for Enterprise), image-only documents lead to failed validation and onboarding pauses [NL-015#NL-015-S04][NL-031#NL-031-S04].

- **Support and remediation escalation**: When tenants fail UAT thresholds due to such extraction/OCR errors, a mandatory remediation path is triggered—implementation is paused, a corpus audit is initiated, and additional support hours or escalated steering committee reviews are allocated [NL-005#NL-005-S11]. Recurring blockers are then reviewed monthly against onboarding metrics and support ticket patterns [NL-005#NL-005-S11].

- **Support/operational provisions**: Because these OCR issues are so common among legacy corpora, NovaLearn specifically provisions an "Advanced OCR Ingestion Queue" for enterprise customers as part of its onboarding extensions [NL-005#NL-005-S09]. Additionally, OCR batches can clog the import queue—the March 14 upload outage was triggered by an import worker retry storm—demonstrating that import issues degrade overall system onboarding performance unless split-queue architecture and concurrency limits are enforced [NL-021#NL-021-S06].

In summary, OCR/import issues directly inflate onboarding timelines, cause UAT failures that trigger mandatory support remediation, and necessitate special queue-management and enterprise-level support provisions to mitigate their impact.
